Example WildObs Data Packages

Source: R/example_datapackages.R
example_datapackages.Rd

Reads the two WildObs projects shipped with the package, so examples, tests and tutorials run offline on real data. They come back in the same shape as wildobs_dp_download() returns: a named list of Camtrap DP data packages, each with its tables in resources and date-times in the project's local time zone. Read the tables with frictionless::read_resource(). A copy also sits in dp$data, because the camtrapdp class expects one, but other tools do not always keep it up to date.

The two projects have different designs, regions and seasons:

ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001

Systematic, unbaited cameras on roads, trails and off-trail across six national parks in the Queensland Wet Tropics, 2022-23: 275 deployments at 145 stations, most with two cameras.

NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010

Unbaited cameras at wombat burrows and at nearby controls in Woomargama National Park, New South Wales, over four surveys in 2021-22 that form one multi-season group: 219 deployments at 28 stations, in the time zone Australia/Sydney.

Both are open and licensed CC-BY-4.0; cite them with cite_datapackages(). They are copies of the public data at the time the package was built (see versionControlWildObs), with three differences from a live download: only animal observations are kept, there is no media table, and the email addresses of contributors and sources are left out. Threatened-species records stay obscured, exactly as the public API serves them. The copies are rebuilt by dev/make_example_data.R in the package source.

Usage

example_datapackages(
  project_ids = c("ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001",
    "NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010")
)

Arguments

project_ids

Which projects to read. Defaults to both. Use example_datapackages(project_ids = NULL) to list the available IDs without reading anything.

Value

A named list of data packages of class camtrapdp, one per project, with deployments, observations and covariates tables. With project_ids = NULL, the character vector of available project IDs. Stops if an ID is not one of them.

See also

wildobs_dp_download() for the full, current data from the WildObs database.

Author

Zachary Amir

Examples

# the projects shipped with WildObsR
example_datapackages(project_ids = NULL)
#> [1] "NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010"
#> [2] "ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001"           

# read both, exactly as wildobs_dp_download() would return them
dp_list <- example_datapackages()
names(dp_list)
#> [1] "ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001"           
#> [2] "NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010"
deps <- frictionless::read_resource(dp_list[[1]], "deployments")
head(deps[, c("deploymentID", "deploymentStart", "baitUse")])
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   deploymentID                      deploymentStart     baitUse
#>   <chr>                             <dttm>              <lgl>  
#> 1 CFRAG_01_WildObsID_0001_2022_Cam1 2022-12-15 08:52:45 FALSE  
#> 2 CFRAG_01_WildObsID_0001_2022_Cam2 2022-12-15 08:19:27 FALSE  
#> 3 CFRAG_02_WildObsID_0001_2022_Cam1 2022-12-15 09:58:36 FALSE  
#> 4 CFRAG_02_WildObsID_0001_2022_Cam2 2022-12-15 09:40:56 FALSE  
#> 5 CFRAG_03_WildObsID_0001_2022_Cam1 2022-12-15 11:00:58 FALSE  
#> 6 CFRAG_03_WildObsID_0001_2022_Cam2 2022-12-15 10:36:47 FALSE  

# and cite them
cite_datapackages(dp_list)
#>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001 
#> "Zachary Amir, Tom Bruce & Matthew Luskin (2022). WildObs Camera Trap Data Package: Zachary Amir's camera trap surveys from 6 national parks in QLD's Wet Tropics rainforests from late 2022 to early 2023 targeting feral and native vertebrates [Camera Trap Data Package]. WildObs National Wildlife Camera Database. https://wildobs.org.au. RAiD: https://raid.org/10.83062/cb5829ab. WildObs data package version 1.1.1." 
#>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010 
#>                                                                        "Grant Linley, Chris Jolly & Emma E Spencer (2021). WildObs Camera Trap Data Package: Wombat burrows are hotspots for small vertebrates in a landscape subject to gigafire [Camera Trap Data Package]. WildObs National Wildlife Camera Database. https://wildobs.org.au. RAiD: https://raid.org/10.83062/9eec588a. WildObs data package version 1.0.3."
